body: Video-note chrome moved OUT of the circular clip: the note bubble is now one meta line taller than its circle (measureMessageBubbleLayout adds metaTopSpacing+bubbleMetaHeight for .videoNote), mediaFrame is the top square, and time+status (metaContainerView, back in contentView) sit bottom-right on that line with the duration label bottom-left. Only the mute pill stays inside the circle. Tap-scale (1.24x) removed, playback ring 3.5->2.0, size/byte label suppressed for notes. Verified by a generic-iOS build; NOT yet installed on device (xcodebuild could not see the phone).
author: Vibe Team
